content.rendered:
Sherwood Middle School is pleased to host our drop in Fall Conferences this Thursday from 4:30-8:00PM and again on Friday from 10:00AM to 12:00PM.  We recently created an informational video that helps explain some of the nuances of our Standards Based Grading process.  Please feel free to watch this short video if you are interested and know that the grades become much more accurate and solidified as we collect more evidence of learning.  We will also host a SBG booth at our conference sessions for parent convenience.  

We hope to see you at conferences!

Sincerely,

Andy Van Fleet

Principal 

Sherwood Middle School
